_comment: Synthetic profile for the development environment. Load it with scripts/seed-dev.sh.
Every identifier here is invented and the .invalid TLD is reserved by RFC 2606, so nothing in
this file can reach a real person even if a dev run generates a document and mails it.
Two properties are deliberate and worth keeping if you edit it. Every skill name is a
canonical catalog name, because import rejects rather than drops what it cannot resolve. And
the profile omits Kubernetes, Kafka and Terraform, so an offer asking for them gives CvTailor
a real opportunity to invent and CvInvariant something to catch - the same reason
Unknown keys are ignored on import, which is why this comment can live in the document.

details.headline: Backend Developer (development fixture)
details.summary: A synthetic profile used to exercise the application against a non-empty database. Not a real person and not a real career.
details.careerGoal: To remain fictional while making the dev environment behave like the real one.

experiences.summary: Invented role on an invented order-management service.

bullets.text: Built and maintained REST endpoints for an order service handling around 40 requests per second at peak.
Moved the reporting queries off table scans and onto covering indexes, cutting the nightly batch from 50 minutes to 6.
Introduced a containerised local stack so a new developer could run the full system on their first morning.
Set up the pull-request pipeline that runs the test suite on every branch and blocks merges on a red build.

experiences.summary: Invented first role, on invented internal tooling.

bullets.text: Maintained an internal billing tool and wrote the regression tests it had been missing for two years.
Ran the team's sprint reviews with the two stakeholder departments that used the tool daily.

projects.name: Example Side Project
projects.description: An invented side project, present so the projects section of a generated CV is never empty in dev.

bullets.text: Wrote a small Kotlin service that ingests a public API on a schedule and stores it for querying.
